sentences.text: No, Schedule II, row 3 does not comply with the current RBI rule for this case, because for a floating rate loan granted to an individual for a purpose other than business, pre-payment charges are not permitted.
The Home Loan Agreement dated 2026-02-10 states that row 3 is a pre-payment charge of 2% of principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.
The applicable RBI finding for this borrower type, purpose, and rate type says an RE shall not levy pre-payment charges.
